I used the following team for both XPWAA and XPWCC in the following order and vs. Ambuscade:

  1. AA/CC
  2. Dark Visionary
  3. Super Scientific Tachyon
  4. Grandpa Legacy
  5. Ra

Dark Visionary stacks the bottom of the unlockee's deck so that Super Scientific Tachyon can put pairs of the needed cards into play.  Grandpa Legacy gives extra power usages for whoever needs them.  Ra is just there for damage output so that it's easy to kill off Ambuscade once you've achieved the unlock conditions.
